name: Nani yo!! Shojo Ageru wa yo
original_name: 何よっ!!処女あげるわよっ
source:
There is an old castle with vampires ...
But some day hero appears and defeats the monsters. But surprisingly he undergoes a metamorphosis.
Wizards, tentacles and vagrants welcome this sudden change.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
